item.title: Code Mode for MCP
item.description: LLMs are excellent at writing code, but bad at making business decisions. Cloudflare’s Code Mode idea – let the model write the script, and let an expert system run it – is a natural fit for EITL. A claims-processing example in the Talon language.

item.title: Enterprise AI Orchestration
item.description: Managing AI agents in the enterprise means solving for security, knowledge access, and orchestration at the same time. A look at OpenTalon – an EITL-first framework that combines LLMs with expert rules for corporate AI architecture.

item.title: LLM, Neural Network, or Expert System?
item.description: Each kind of system makes a different kind of decision. LLMs generate language, neural networks find patterns, expert systems make the call. A look at why the boundary matters – and how the real world runs on it.

item.title: Expert in the Loop (EITL)
item.description: Why Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) is a bottleneck, and how Expert-in-the-Loop (EITL) with deterministic expert systems alongside LLMs offers a better paradigm for AI-driven decision making.
